name: Can I convert my existing drawers to soft close, or do I need new cabinets?

mainEntity.name: Can I convert my existing drawers to soft close, or do I need new cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often, you can convert existing drawers to soft close without needing entirely new cabinets. This typically involves replacing your current drawer slides with soft close slides of a compatible size and type. Some systems also allow for adding an external soft close mechanism to existing standard slides. The feasibility depends on your current drawer construction and available space. A professional assessment can determine the best approach for your specific cabinets.
acceptedAnswer.description: Many existing drawers can be converted to soft close by replacing slides or adding an external mechanism, depending on drawer construction.
